result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Dropbox Sign, DocuSign, and PandaDoc** are the three e-signature platforms I'd shortlist.

My recommendation depends on whether you simply need customers to sign documents or want a more complete system for quotes, proposals, contracts and approvals.

Here's how I'd compare the leading options.

## Best e-signature software compared

| Software | Best for | My verdict |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Simple contracts and signing | Best straightforward choice |
| DocuSign | Professional business contracts | Best all-rounder |
| PandaDoc | Quotes, proposals and contracts | Best for sales-focused businesses |
| Signable | UK small businesses | Worth considering for UK-based support |
| Adobe Acrobat Sign | PDF-heavy businesses | Best if you already use Adobe |
| SignWell | Freelancers and low-volume signing | Good budget alternative |


### My top three

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign — best for simplicity**

- Easy to upload PDFs and send for signing.
- Reusable templates and signing workflows.
- Good integrations with cloud storage.
- Particularly suitable for straightforward customer agreements.

Website: [Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign — best all-rounder**

- Widely recognised by customers and suppliers.
- Strong audit trails and document tracking.
- Lots of integrations with other business software.
- Good if you expect your business to grow.

Website: [DocuSign UK](https://www.docusign.com/en-gb)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc — best for contracts and proposals**

- Create professional-looking proposals.
- Build quotes and contracts.
- Collect signatures online.
- Track when customers open and sign documents.

Website: [PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

These are different types of products: Dropbox Sign and DocuSign concentrate on signing, whereas PandaDoc also helps create and manage sales documents. [www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-esign-software-solution-of-2026-compare-docusign-signnow-adobe-sign-and-more/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-digital-signature-apps/?welcome=signup&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.helprange.com](https://www.helprange.com/e-signature-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What about pricing?

Some useful UK pricing benchmarks\:

| Platform | Published pricing indication |
|--------|--------|
| Signable | Pay as you go from £2.60/envelope |
| Dropbox Sign | From around \$15/month |
| DocuSign | Tiered monthly or annual subscriptions |
| PandaDoc | Free tier; paid plans from \$19/user/month billed annually |


Signable's published pricing also includes an Essentials plan at £40 + VAT/month, billed annually, with 300 envelopes. Check current plan limits before subscribing. [www.signable.com](https://www.signable.com/plans/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.helprange.com](https://www.helprange.com/e-signature-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.pandadoc.com](https://www.pandadoc.com/blog/best-electronic-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Important for UK businesses

Electronic signatures are generally valid for most commercial contracts in England and Wales. However, certain documents have additional execution requirements, such as witnessing or specific formalities. [www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/electronic-execution-of-documents?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[assets.publishing.service.gov.uk](https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/912233/Electronic-Execution-Report.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.lawsociety.org.uk](https://www.lawsociety.org.uk/topics/business-management/execution-of-a-document-using-and-electronic-signature?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I'd prioritise\:

- A downloadable signed PDF.
- A full audit trail and timestamp.
- Automatic email reminders.
- Reusable contract templates.
- GDPR and data-protection provisions.
- Appropriate signer identity verification.

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a typical small UK business\:

- **Signable** for a UK-focused, straightforward signing service.
- **Dropbox Sign** for simple, modern document signing.
- **DocuSign** for a more established, scalable business solution.
- **PandaDoc** if quotes and proposals are a big part of your business.

## One question to narrow it down

What type of small business are you running?

For example, consultancy, construction, recruitment, property, professional services, or something else?

That will help me recommend the best platform based on the documents you'll actually be sending, rather than paying for features you don't need.

search_results.title: The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
